submitted.rationale: Mg–Sb–O phases (MgO, MgSb2O6 trirutile, Mg4Sb2O9) are wide-gap insulators. Mg2+ has no d-states, so 2.1 eV photons should not be absorbed. All measured EQEs were effectively zero (~1e-5 %). The highest reading was at the Sb-richest end, index 26 (0.00033 %), possibly from sub-gap or Sb-oxide defect absorption. Differences between compositions are at the noise level.

rejected.reason: MgSb2O6 trirutile composition; EQE 0.00002%, same as noise
